sources.title: Iron Force Industrial Co., Ltd. 2025 Annual Report (English translation)
sources.locator: PDF pp.168–169 (printed pp.165–166): current major products include Impact Airbag Inflator Sub Assembly and Precision Pipe & Pinion of Pretensioner Seatbelt. PDF pp.171–172 (printed pp.168–169) lists Group A and Group B as principal sales customers for 2024/2025, with 49.73% and 23.27% of 2025 sales respectively; names are anonymized.
sources.note: Current issuer disclosure supports the products and customer concentration, but does not identify named customers or their product-specific share.

sources.title: Iron Force Industrial Co., Ltd. investor presentation (2014-03-28)
sources.effective_period: Historical customer and product-share data for 2012.
sources.locator: PDF p.9: customer table lists Autoliv with 55% of airbag-supplier sales and 41% of seatbelt-supplier sales; Autoliv, Takata and TRW total 93% of airbag sales, 79% of seatbelt sales and 88% overall (2012). Iron Force estimates its own 2012 pretensioner tube share at 15.09% and airbag-inflator-parts share at 12.78%.
sources.note: Issuer primary source. The customer-system percentages and Iron Force part-share estimates refer to different subjects and must not be conflated.

sources.title: ImportInfo: ZF Passive Safety Systems US Inc. U.S. import activity

sources.title: ImportInfo: Joyson Safety Systems Acquisition LLC U.S. import activity
sources.effective_period: Bills of lading accessed 2026-10-06; entries dated 2026-07-17 through 2026-09-05 include shipments by Iron Force Industrial.
sources.locator: Visible entries list IRON FORCE INDUSTRIAL as shipper and JOYSON SAFETY SYSTEMS ACQUISITION LLC as consignee. Commodity descriptions state AUTO PARTS; one July 17, 2026 entry says AUTO PARTS (CCI HOUSING). They do not specifically identify airbag shells or pretensioner tubes.

sources.title: Global Market Insights: Automotive Airbag Inflator Market Statistics, 2026–2035
sources.effective_period: Page accessed 2026-10-06; reported market shares are for 2023.
sources.locator: Market-share section reports Autoliv 43.71%, ZF 11.56%, and Joyson Safety Systems 7.83% of the 2023 automotive airbag-inflator market (combined 63.10%). This is a secondary estimate for a broader inflator market and not the specific upstream inflator-shell/pretensioner-tube market in the claim.
sources.note: Used as an adjacent-market cross-check only; its market definition differs from the component-level claim.

search_notes: 將現行產品、各具名客戶關係、客戶是否屬主要客戶，以及 90%+ 市占拆成獨立判斷。
核對劍麟2025年英文年報、2014年官方法說簡報及截至2026年的美國進口提單彙整。年報確認現行產品但把大客戶匿名為Group A/B。
2014年官方簡報以2012資料區分客戶端集中度（Autoliv/Takata/TRW）與劍麟自己的零件市占；兩者不可互換。
2026年提單支持對ZF與Joyson出貨汽車零件，但Joyson貨品描述未具體列出氣囊殼體或預縮器管件，且提單不能證明客戶營收重要性。
查到的2023年全球氣囊充氣器市場估算中，Autoliv、ZF、Joyson合計63.10%；其市場邊界不同於上游殼體/管件，因此沒有將該數字直接套用或當作嚴格反證。
沒有找到與原句同期間、同產品範圍且說明分母的90%+來源；保留 UNKNOWN。
